commenti.body:
i remember watching this movie as a teenager. 

i loved Jeremy Renner. 

...and that in the ending he's so fucked up that he rather goes back than staying with his family. 

So for me it's one of the best war movie scenes in my memory but the rest of the movie I completely forgot. I think it is strong but missing the very memorable scenes.

Jeremy Renner is terrific.

Yeah it’s certainly not an iconic film, but I don’t understand some of the derision aimed at it. I thought it was powerful, focused, and very affecting.
